question: Steve’s empty swimming pool will hold \(24{,}000\) gallons of water when full. It will be filled by \(4\) hoses, each of which supplies \(2.5\) gallons of water per minute. How many hours will it take to fill Steve’s pool?
solution:
All four hoses fill the pool at the same time, so their rates add. Together they supply
\[
4\times2.5=10
\]
gallons per minute. Dividing the required amount by the amount supplied each minute gives
\[
24{,}000\div10=2400\text{ minutes}.
\]
Since each hour contains \(60\) minutes, the filling time is
\[
2400\div60=40\text{ hours}.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{40}\) hours, choice A.
